All 28 tests pass with `mvn test -Dtest=FastDatePrinterAgentTest`, build success, no other files modified.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDatePrinterAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class (no inheritance, matching the project's Jupiter/`assert*` style) covering `FastDatePrinter`'s public API: getters (`getPattern`, `getTimeZone`, `getLocale`, `getMaxLengthEstimate`), all `format` overloads (Date/Calendar/long × String/Appendable/StringBuffer, plus the deprecated `Object` overload), `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`, serialization round-trip, and boundary/error cases (null pattern → NPE, illegal pattern letter, invalid `XXXX` length, empty pattern, low-year padding, ISO-8601/RFC-822 timezone formatting, week-year fields, and timezone-override semantics for `Calendar` formatting).
